title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike Russian chemical plant
summary: Explosions and a large fire were seen emanating from the plant just after midnight following the reported attack, according to monitoring channel Exilenova Plus.

title: Russia launches mass missile attack against Ukraine after Putin vows retaliation
summary: Explosions rocked Kyiv at around 1:25 a.m. on Nov. 20, according to Kyiv Independent journalists on the ground. Earlier, monitoring channels reported that Russia had launched Tu-160 strategic bombers.

title: Zelensky tells world superpowers how they can end Russia's war against Ukraine
summary: "If you want to stop war, stop trade with Russia," Zelensky told reporters following a Coalition of the Meeting summit in Berlin on Nov. 19.
